facts.label: cash from operations, Nov 2025 to Jul 2026

what: It designs, builds and tests spacecraft hardware and provides space engineering services to NASA, private companies and non-profit groups.
proceeds: It expects about $7.993 million in net proceeds. Roughly $1 million would repay notes, up to $4.25 million would go to research and development, and the rest to sales, facilities, manufacturing and working capital.
risks: It will need more money than it has, and may not be able to raise it on good terms, or at all.
It has had promissory note defaults. All have been resolved, but its cash is tight and new defaults could happen.
Its auditors have said there is serious doubt the company can keep operating without raising more money.
It found weaknesses in its financial controls, which could lead to late or inaccurate financial reports.
It has lost money every year and has a large accumulated deficit. It expects more losses.
